## What this changes

<!-- One sentence. If this is a registry record, name the project. -->

## Change class

- [ ] Registry record (new project / update / correction)
- [ ] Relationship assertion
- [ ] Evidence or claim
- [ ] Proposal (`proposals/OTCS-NNNN/`)
- [ ] Protocol / schema (requires a ratified proposal)
- [ ] Documentation / tooling / fix

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`) — see DCO.md

## For registry records

- [ ] I am authorized to represent this project, **or** I am transcribing with the owner's knowledge (say which)
- [ ] `non_claims` is filled in — what the project does *not* claim
- [ ] Evidence states are honest; nothing self-tested is labeled independently tested
- [ ] Maturity is a profile, not a single number

## For relationship assertions

- [ ] Status is `self_asserted` unless the counterparty has signed off in this PR
- [ ] `asserted_by` and `evidence` are filled in

## Disclosures

- [ ] Conflicts of interest disclosed (or "none")
- [ ] Material AI assistance disclosed (AI-USE.md)
